rationale: Released room creation can turn an inherited off-grid source coordinate into a distinct rounded scalar and falsely refuse the write. Released Optimize also misclassifies its exact retained-carrier Align trim as unproved removal. Preserve source provenance and independently prove only the established Align/storage result, keeping structural and opening guards.

summary.ru: Создание комнаты сохраняет точные исходные узлы вне сетки; допустимое выравнивание носителя принимается сервером без снятия защит.
summary.en: Room creation preserves exact inherited off-grid nodes; the server accepts proved carrier alignment while retaining its safety guards.
